_comment: A6 cross-platform interoperability matrix. Completion gate 3 is BLOCKED by the user-confirmed device availability (no Android device and no usable Android emulator; BLE peripheral/advertising is not emulable; only one iPhone, unavailable to the toolchain). Radio-independent rows are separated from radio-dependent rows and must never be presented as physical-device coverage.
